text:
marta-cs: Hey, customer reports intermittent 403 when calling generate + embeddings after SSO provisioning. Happens only for newly provisioned svc keys.

marta-cs: Sample curl: curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -> 403 {"error":"insufficient_scopes"}

sam-ops: Can you paste the raw token JWT (redact kid)?

marta-cs: pasted in thread: eyJhbGci...REDACTED...eyJzY29wZSI6ImVtYmVkZGluZ3MrZ2VuZXJhdGUiLCJzdWIiOiJ0ZW5hbnQxIn0.

jia-platform: whoa — scope claim contains plus signs: "embeddings+generate" — provisioner seems to url-encode spaces to + on the claim string.

alex-sec: many auth parsers treat scope as space-delimited per RFC. If claim has + it's treated as single scope 'embeddings+generate' which doesn't match allowed scopes.

sam-ops: Does the authz layer normalize + -> space? Search logs: authz: allowed=['embeddings','rerank'] token.scopes=['embeddings+generate'] => deny

marta-cs: customer workaround: we told them to create a manual API key in console (non-SSO) and it worked immediately.

jia-platform: quick fix: update provisioner to percent-decode claim or replace '+' with ' '. I'll push a hotfix to provisioner service to stop using application/x-www-form-urlencoded encoding for claim blob.

infra-bot: deploy triggered: provisioner/v1.4.7 -> canary

sam-ops: add unit test that encodes a space, ensures final JWT.scope uses literal spaces. Also backfill a migration to re-issue recent keys for affected tenants.

alex-sec: follow-up: check downstream token validators (oauth lib) to ensure they don't mis-handle plus signs.

marta-cs: I'll notify the impacted customer and schedule a short maintenance window for key re-issuance. Thanks team :thumbsup:
